name: listing.warranty
title: Field: listing.warranty
description: Meaning of the buyer-visible listing.warranty field.
text:
# listing.warranty

TL;DR:
- listing.warranty describes the warranty mode attached to the listing.

What it means:
- warranty: the listing includes warranty support.
- no-warranty: no warranty is provided.
- custom: the warranty situation exists but needs custom reading from listing context or future product surface.

Agent hint:
- When warranty is custom, avoid overclaiming exact legal coverage without more context.
